releases.title: Corporate site copy updated
notes: Company: the Hawkes Biomedical site now uses a more formal, measured tone from the home page through to the laboratory notices.
Notices: company announcements are now written in a plainer, more exact register, with fewer embellishments.
Products: each product page now describes its formulation in the company's standard clinical format.

releases.title: Products page now fits smaller screens
notes: The Products page now fits within narrow phone screens, so no text runs off the edge.
The site menu stays fully visible on the Products page on small screens.

releases.title: Release notices and formulation links updated
notes: Release notices are now written in a more consistent corporate register, with the same structure across each product line.
Dates in release notices now display in the correct format and sequence throughout the site.
Formulation links now wrap cleanly within the page, so long names no longer run past the edge of the screen.

releases.title: Anonymous site statistics, on the record
notes: Anonymous site statistics are now kept across the public record, with no cookies and no personal data collected.

releases.title: Laboratory notice format
notes: Public notices now follow the standard Hawkes Biomedical laboratory record format.

releases.title: Every lot, on the record
notes: Each product dossier now lists its current formulation, active lot and revision date.
Every product in the Hawkes Biomedical line now publishes its current formulation status.
Hawkes Gen (laboratory services: on-demand synthesis) joins the public product line.
All public records now carry the Hawkes Gen laboratory synthesis mark.

releases.title: The product line, on the record
notes: The full Hawkes Biomedical product line, each with its clinical indication.
Corporate charter, board leadership and Zurich capital desk contact, on the public record.
